name: Ominous Catalyst

pages.text: Throw into a volcano toward the Volcanic Core to summon Luxtructosaurus.

pages.title: Crafting
pages.text: The recipe surrounds an Amber Curiosity with eight Heavy Bones. Curiosities can occasionally be found when breaking amber in the Primordial Caves. JEI shows the complete layout.

pages.title: Offering
pages.text: At a Primordial Caves volcano, throw the item inside toward the Volcanic Core. The core attracts the catalyst and consumes one after a successful summon. Holding it or dropping it on ordinary stone is insufficient.

pages.title: After summoning
pages.text: The boss and tephra make the area dangerous. On a dedicated server retain Start confirmation. $(l:handbook/bosses/alexscaves/luxtructosaurus)Luxtructosaurus preparation and attacks$(/l).

jem_summary: Throw into a volcano toward the Volcanic Core to summon Luxtructosaurus.
